# Additive tuning of 2026-11-06, mcp round 1 confirmation, scenario 5

## Run identity

```yaml
model: claude-sonnet-5
served_version: claude-sonnet-5
tree: sha256:057cf511b2890aed9cfbd04883cd9ceae65434dc68bd53e29d8202435d670834
lock: sha256:826dcf9f83c5d9e7fb557d7a1df9753a09a5c70c645d6c9faf7a575256119178
selection: sha256:d99530b2b639bb6bdd279be2a9356a64ce2a0c8cceca354d56957f198a76a20a
read_set: sha256:2a47d5b0401ca6d3239d352781fe101f4d7ba74c60c6a0dbe460e46ae9703c4d
seed: 0
harness: 0.6.1
tier: additive
arm: scenario-5
at: 2026-11-06
cost_cents: 14323
```

**This line is the confirmation of round 1 of the MCP layer, in the tuning round of the additive campaign that [#1880](https://github.com/headwater-ai/headwater/issues/1880) asked for.** Round 1 screened four variants at 22 sessions each, and variant 4 ranked first, with the MCP layer used in 21 of 22 sessions ([the screen of variant 4](additive-tuning-of-2026-11-06-mcp-round-1-variant-4-scenario-5.md)). The confirmation runs that variant again at 154 sessions, against the best so far measured at the same count. Variant 4 combines an `instructions` text sent with `initialize`, which names the usual install locations of the command line and prefers the MCP tools to it, the descriptions that say when to call each tool, and the text format as the default of `check`. `tools/probe/try.sh launch` ran it from the one-line spec `additive scenario-5 tuning`. It is the `scenario-5` arm of the additive tier over the 22 probes of the tuning set, at 7 repetitions per probe, on `claude-sonnet-5` under Claude Code 2.1.288.

**One tree, one pin, one launch.** Every session ran in a fresh copy of a `git archive` of the pinned tree, and the engine of that tree. The pin was `c34e84d6`, on the pushed branch `tune/mcp-r1-v4`, for the whole batch, and it is the commit the screen of variant 4 ran at. The base it is read against is scenario 2 at `329f3362`, which the owner adopted from the engine layer [on the issue](https://github.com/headwater-ai/headwater/issues/1880#issuecomment-6656833332), and the owner accepted the change to the MCP server against that base ([comment 6656833861](https://github.com/headwater-ai/headwater/issues/1880#issuecomment-6656833861)). The canary of 8 sessions cost 761 cents, and the owner read its records and [passed it](https://github.com/headwater-ai/headwater/issues/1880#issuecomment-6680856991). The driver then halted four times at 53 of 154 sessions and six times at 151 of 154, each time when the harness failed in the way that a usage limit stops a session. It continued in the same try root at the same pin, and it did not launch the batch again. The `tree` digest in the identity above is the digest the assembly recorded.

**What the recorder counted.** The line holds 154 sessions and cost 14323 cents: the intent hook live in 0, 0 stopped at the turn cap, 0 stopped at the session budget, 300 paths outside the workspace named, 0 sessions uncounted, 0 web-tool calls. 146 of the 154 sessions used the MCP layer, against 101 of 154 in the best so far. A session the recorder could not count adds nothing to either count, so each count is a floor.

**The result.** Scenario 5 with variant 4 passed 108 of the 154 sessions it graded, 70%. The keep row compares this line with the best so far of the layer, which passed 116 of 154 ([the best so far](additive-tuning-of-2026-11-06-mcp-round-1-best-so-far-scenario-5.md)). The difference is -5.2 points, with the interval [-15.0, +4.7]. The interval includes zero, so the change is not kept under the owner's rule of 2026-10-20 (#1777, ruling 7). The base row compares this line with the base, scenario 2, which passed 112 of 154 ([the base](additive-tuning-of-2026-11-02-engine-round-1-best-so-far-scenario-2.md)): -2.6 points, with the interval [-12.6, +7.5]. `try.sh result` closed round 1 of the MCP layer as not kept, and the best so far at `cce750f7` stays the layer's best so far. The variant reached the MCP tools in more sessions and did not solve more tasks.

**The contract of this batch.** The sessions ran under the recorder contract of spec 15: a `bwrap` sandbox with no network of its own, a configuration directory that holds a copy of the credentials and nothing else, the permission mode `dontAsk`, and `WebSearch` and `WebFetch` denied. The owner approved $1,300.00 for this layer. The driver ran this try with a cap of 20000 cents and a session budget of 300 cents. The owner raised the cap from 15000 cents for this launch ([comment 6678059833](https://github.com/headwater-ai/headwater/issues/1880#issuecomment-6678059833)).

**What the batch cost.** The driver charged 14591 cents against its cap. The 154 recorded sessions account for 14323 cents, the 761 cents of the canary included. The other 268 cents are the partial cost of the sessions that the halts stopped, which the driver recorded again. A confirmation is charged to the tuning ceiling, which now holds 23439 of 100000 cents.

**Where the raw recordings are.** The raw session logs are outside git, under `/mnt/build/hw-1880/mcp-r1-confirm/a/sessions/L1-*/raw.jsonl` on the host that ran the batch. Nobody deletes them until the report of [#1779](https://github.com/headwater-ai/headwater/issues/1779) is published.

**Where the other figures are.** The rate and the interval of each probe are in the generated result that reads this transcript.
